args.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/components/Toast.tsx uses a single aria-live="polite" container for all toasts and sets an auto-dismiss timer of 5 seconds for every toast regardless of kind. To fix this, change the live region aria-live to "assertive" for error toasts or split into separate containers, and prevent error toasts from auto-dismissing after five seconds so they stay until dismissed.
